json.justification: Photo 14 shows the completed installation: a Base battery unit mounted on a concrete pad flush against the brick wall immediately left of the meter/panel/disconnect stack, with a second unit (inverter/other equipment) also installed further left near the AC condenser. The harness conduit runs a short, fully supported path directly from the meter/panel assembly down and over to the battery, well under 16 ft. Ground in front of the battery is dirt/grass with several feet of clearance to the wooden fence line (visible in photo 1 as fence set back well beyond typical yard depth, easily 10+ ft), satisfying the ~5 ft facing clearance. No gas equipment, pool, driveway, or operable window/door is in this footprint. Since the installation is already shown complete and functional in photo 14, this confirms a valid, workable battery spot was found and used.
